title: Full Extractors for Logical Processing in Hypergraph Product Codes
summary: Quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes are promising candidates for practical low-overhead quantum memories. For large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computation, we further need logical processing methods for QLDPC codes. In this work, we construct full extractors---surgery systems capable of measuring arbitrary logical Pauli operators on a code block---for several hypergraph product (HGP) codes.
